mapper.select: SELECT l.likes_id, p.perfume_id, p.image_route, p.brand, p.perfume_name, p.price, a.accord_name FROM ( SELECT l2.likes_id, l2.perfume_id, l2.create_time FROM likes l2 JOIN perfume p2 ON l2.perfume_id = p2.perfume_id WHERE l2.member_id = #{memberId} AND l2.is_delete = FALSE AND p2.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY l2.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) l JOIN perfume p ON l.perfume_id = p.perfume_id LEFT JOIN perfume_accord pa ON p.perfume_id = pa.perfume_id AND pa.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id AND a.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, pa.accord_order
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.likes_id) FROM likes l JOIN perfume p ON l.perfume_id = p.perfume_id WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId} AND l.is_delete = FALSE AND p.is_delete = FALSE

SELECT p.perfume_id, p.image_route, p.brand, p.perfume_name, p.price, a.accord_name FROM ( SELECT l.perfume_id FROM likes l JOIN perfume p2 ON l.perfume_id = p2.perfume_id WHERE l.is_delete = FALSE AND p2.is_delete = FALSE GROUP BY l.perfume_id ORDER BY COUNT(l.likes_id) DESC LIMIT 5 ) top5 JOIN perfume p ON top5.perfume_id = p.perfume_id LEFT JOIN perfume_accord pa ON p.perfume_id = pa.perfume_id AND pa.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id AND a.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY pa.accord_order
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM likes WHERE member_id = #{userId} AND perfume_id = #{perfumeId}
